comment: He is a great guy. Very friendly and makes class fun. I actually look forward to going to class. He is also a good teacher, the material is presented and explained and I have learned a lot. I am changing my major to comm studies mainly because of him, I didn't know I was interested in this subject until I took his class
Very easy class. John cares about what you think! Very flexible and friendly. Must get an A if you turn in everything.
Dr. Feaster is the man. He really cares about what he does, and he is quirky (loves Star Trek), but guaranteed A. if you turn in everything

Really easy class. If you study for the tests they are super easy. The response papers are really easy too. He's very enthusiastic about communications which was nice, but I found the class very boring since I'm not interested in that area of study
